recent.text: You chose an ordinary beginning without a system.

systems_workshop.terms.value: Iona has 100 local coins, 30 grant points and finite workshop stock. Claims require work after accepting the exact contract. Seam reading is permanent learning; remote guidance is a separate revocable lease. Ren owns two logs and learns independently. No closed-browser production.

systems_workshop.refusal.value: No work, debt or reward was created by refusal. The offer remains available.

systems_workshop.contract.value: Revision 1: make a kit after acceptance using one own log; completion witnesses actual materials and output. Claim once: 10 points from Iona, plus one unopened workshop cache. Declining contact later does not alter already earned terms.

systems_workshop.wages.value: Four coins moved from Iona’s finite purse to yours for completed sorting. Repeated work drains her actual purse.

systems_workshop.objective.value: Witnessed: the accepted commission consumed your log and produced an actual prepared survey kit. A preexisting kit alone was not evidence.

systems_workshop.reward.value: The first objective was adjudicated once; Iona’s grant authority funded ten points. Cache custody is actual native inventory.

systems_workshop.seam_method.value: Learned seam reading belongs to you. It can guide lens inspection and ordinary kit work without Iona’s remote support.

systems_workshop.assist.value: While in contact, ledger guidance makes two kits from one log. The lease does not teach its algorithm.

systems_workshop.upgrade.value: Module revision 2 adds stabilized sample dispatch. Preparation remains available; this is new scope, not a global ability level.

systems_workshop.disconnected.value: Remote assistance stopped. Earned seam reading, goods and accepted commission terms remain yours.

missed.shower.value: The shower passed; the craftsman dried his bench. No missed reward is owed.

systems_workshop.cache_pool.value: Opening commits a fresh seeded draw: glass phial or counted fitting pin, equal weights. The unopened cache has no determined content. Duplicates can be kept for craft or sold; no pity/reroll.

systems_workshop.inspection.value: Your crafted lens and learned method examine an actual carried survey kit. You establish its seam-refit specification, not a universal identification method.

systems_workshop.aligned_use.value: Iona received the actual refitted kit and paid from her purse for precision dispatch. Its original frame and your new pin were transformed, not copied.

systems_workshop.seal.value: Fixed revision 1: prepared sealed rations and sample parcels remain stable until their declared handoff. Ordinary phial preparation supplies each package. The cheat itself does not level.

systems_workshop.ordinary_ration.value: The same phial and meat make an ordinary courier ration. Its four-minute prepared window expires on the played local clock; a Stillglass ration remains usable after that window. Raw ingredients have no new global expiry rule.

systems_workshop.ordinary_parcel.value: This unsealed calibration sample drifts after four played local minutes. A Stillglass parcel retains its calibration beyond that same window.

systems_workshop.ration_use.value: Iona received the actual stable journey ration for her courier and paid from her own purse.

systems_workshop.parcel_use.value: Iona received the actual stable survey sample; its measurement joins her dispatch specification.

systems_workshop.model.value: Represented experiment v1: six ticks, three beds, fixed demand. branched at inlet 3 gives represented harvest 9. Recommendation branched. Exports design knowledge only. No real crops, water, coins or people were created.

systems_workshop.model_applied.value: One actual log was shaped into native irrigation fittings using the versioned represented recommendation. No harvest was imported from rehearsal. Recommended routing produces two fittings; a trial layout produces one.

systems_workshop.field_use.value: Iona installed the actual transferred fittings in her local irrigation repair. Real materials and her own fee settled separately from rehearsal.

systems_workshop.irrigation_use.value: The actual installed fittings now wash and prepare two courier portions from one selected meat and phial batch. This is local physical work, not represented-model harvest exported as goods.

systems_workshop.round.value: Both stakes are in escrow. A seeded fair draw is bound now but hidden until continue. Folding returns your own two coins and Iona’s own two. Continue settles four to the winner once. You can abstain and buy tools instead.

systems_workshop.wager_result.value: The committed sealed draw settled: loss. No new draw was rolled at settlement.

systems_workshop.seam_method.value: Ren learned the ordinary seam method; the teacher’s remote lease is not needed.

systems_workshop.made.value: Used one own log and permanent seam method to make a real kit. Player absence and ledger disconnection did not remove learning.

memories.text: Bought my own completed kit for the agreed coin.
